selection_rationale: All-hip commands lower every modeled foot on all 600 exposed states and act on every stalled state. Qualified-only commands omit unloaded front hips. This is a geometric design choice, not a physical superiority claim.
rule: In raise_body with any weak native foot support, use the all-hip gravity-projected recenter rule. Preserve measured knees except bounded authored-limit return. When all four supports qualify, preserve exact V25 reference targets. Preserve exact V25/V23 establish_distal_support behavior.
input_validation: Reuse existing exact-S169 V25 mathematical input validation and source digest generation. This is not native ownership, energy or task-phase admission; a later composition must supply those.
normal_gravity_rule: If gravity is normal to the joint plane, explicitly hold bounded measured joints and retain the refusal reason. No invented direction.
limitations: Physical contact force, tracking and task completion remain unproven.
The initial fixed-body model does not fully align within 600 updates; no physical deadline extension follows.
Terminal native task requests must refuse before invoking this kernel in any later composition.
